name: Bald Mountain
summary: Metal cab on a 40-foot tower on the Sequoia National Forest, built 1954 or 1955 (sources differ); Forest Service lists summer visiting hours.
design: CL metal 14 by 14 foot cab with corrugated flat roof on a 40-foot Aermotor tower
agency: U.S. Forest Service, Sequoia National Forest

access.note: Forest Service lists summer visiting hours, 9:30 am to 6 pm, Thursday through Monday; pets on a 6-foot leash.

visit.trail_note: From Sherman Pass road (22S05) take the Bald Mountain Lookout road (22S77) and follow until you reach the tower.

events.note: fire-lookouts.org: earlier lookout shown on a 1935 map at a different spot was abandoned when the Sherman Peak lookout was built
Register gives 1954 for the replacement lookout; fire-lookouts.org dates the present structure to 1955
fire-lookouts.org dates the present structure to 1955 (register says 1954)
Logging roads crossed the plateau; fire-lookouts.org says the lookout became accessible to the public
NHLR No. 383, registered June 10, 2001; fire-lookouts.org gives 4/21/1999
Forest engineering assessment, as summarized by fire-lookouts.org: 'not worth the liability or repair'; cab removal planned for spring 2010
Cab removal delayed for lack of funding; volunteer report lists the lookout as abandoned and not staffed
Removed from the threatened list after volunteer groups sought to save it
